title: Numbri Aadmi
desc: Numbri Aadmi is the story of an unknown Robinhood character who helps the poor and honest when they are threatened and harassed by powerful, ruthless and corrupt people. People call him as Numbri Aadmi, but they are unable to trace him, even though he lives among them.

title: Ek Hassina Do Deewane
desc: Amar, an orthodox businessman marries Neeta; slowly he starts mentally torturing her which leads to their divorce. Amar makes a deal with Neeta before filing for a divorce. Will she agree?

title: Bade Dilwala
desc: After losing his daughter, Juhi, in a train accident, Sinha meets her husband, Vijay, and makes him his heir. Then a doctor shows up with an amnesiac Juhi and a dark secret about Vijay.

title: Insaf Apne Lahoo Se
desc: Mahendra Pratap marries Geeta, but asks Devilal, her first son, to leave the house. Later, Geeta gets arrested for murder due to her husband's false testimony and gives birth to another son in prison.

title: Doosri Dulhan
desc: Renu and her husband, Anil, are devastated when she cannot bear children after a miscarriage. But soon, he visits a brothel and asks young Chanda to carry and give birth to a baby for his family.
